description: This file defines an Express.js router for handling analytics-related API endpoints, specifically the '/overview' GET endpoint. It sets up middleware for authentication, validation, and error handling, and links the route to a controller method.

methods.name: analyticsController.overview
methods.description: Handles the logic for providing overview analytics data when the '/analytics/overview' endpoint is called.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware that enforces authentication via bearer token for protected routes.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Middleware that processes validation results and handles errors accordingly.

methods.name: analyticsValidators.overview
methods.description: Validation middleware that ensures the request query parameters for 'from' and 'to' are valid dates.
